shortDescription: See reported vehicle space from transporters you know and beyond.
fullDescription:
Know who has space before you call.

A load comes in. Which transporter has room, and where can their vehicle go? Loadgistic brings reported capacity, routes and approximate locations into one map. Start with the providers you already work with, or explore public options when you need another.

KEEP YOUR NETWORK IN VIEW
Ask transporters to share capacity with your verified email and see their available vehicles together on a private map. A business workspace can help your authorized team coordinate the capacity shared with your company.

SHOW WHERE YOU CAN WORK
Transport Providers publish available space and usual routes for the vehicles they manage, from courier motorcycles and cars to vans and freight trucks. Choose whether a signal is public, shared with contacts, both, or for one recipient. Update availability and approximate location as work changes.

FIND A USEFUL STARTING POINT
Search transporter profiles by account name, handle or manager's first name. Filter the capacity map by vehicle type, route, current load, location source and signal age. Open a vehicle to see what its provider reports, then contact the transporter to confirm fit, timing and terms directly.

KEEP THE AGREED SHIPMENT VISIBLE
After the work is agreed, share private status, route and loading or unloading proof with the people involved. Live vehicle location is limited to the shipment owner and staff they explicitly authorize; other invited viewers see route and status without the moving vehicle.

Built for East African transport work. Available in English, Amharic and Afaan Oromo.

The app asks permission before sharing a driver's phone location. Active shipment tracking may continue when the app is closed. Capacity and shipment maps show approximate vehicle areas; connected GPS trackers send exact positions to the provider's restricted fleet workspace. Notifications are optional. Document badges identify specific records Loadgistic reviewed; they do not guarantee a service. Transport is agreed directly with the provider, without in-app transport payments.
